procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic special tools
notes: Figure 9T in the manual shows: J-6116-01 rear unit holding fixture; J-8092 driver handle; J-21359 pump oil seal installer; J-21364 holding fixture adapter (with J-6116-01); J-2619 slide hammer (with 2619-4 adapter and J-21465-01 removers); J-5154 extension oil seal installer; J-6585 slide hammer weights; J-9539 slide hammer bolts (3/8"-16); J-5590 speedometer gear installer; J-21867 pressure gauge and hose; J-21370-6 rear band apply fixture; J-21370-5 rear band apply pin; J-21795-1 gear unit assembly holding tool and J-21795-2 (part of it); J-5384 converter holding strap; J-21465-01 bushing tool set (parts -5, -3, -2, -1, -17, -8, -13, -6, -15, -16, -9, -10); J-22182 extension bushing remover and installer (not shown).
